# Nourish

> Nourish is an English and Indonesian nutrition tracker for logging meals, comparing intake with daily targets, and following weight trends.

## How Nourish works

- Sign in with a Google account and set a profile, weight goal, usual activity level, and editable daily nutrition targets.
- Take or upload a meal photo. AI estimates the portion and nutrition for one whole dish, including calories and nutrients. Review and correct the estimate before saving it.
- Add a food description to a photo for context, request a revised estimate with more instructions, or describe a meal without a photo.
- Enter a meal and its nutrition manually when an AI estimate is unnecessary or inaccurate.
- View daily intake against nutrition targets, past days on a calendar, and recorded weight history.

## Accuracy and access

Photo and text analyses are estimates. Ingredients, preparation, and portion size can change actual nutrition. Users can edit results before saving. Nourish does not provide medical advice.

Personal profiles, meal records, nutrition targets, and weight history require sign-in. Public pages below explain the service and its policies.
